# Arcanum

> Arcanum is a dark, cosmic mobile app (iOS + Android, not yet published) for tarot spreads, a real natal chart, and daily guidance. Made by VO Digital, a sole proprietorship registered in Kazakhstan.

Arcanum gives full AI-generated readings that interpret the person's actual situation — not just static card meanings. Features: a daily card, tarot spreads (general, relationships, career, near future), a natal chart computed from birth data, and a saved reading history.

The app is not yet available on the App Store or Google Play; this site is a pre-launch landing page.

## Pages

- [Privacy Policy](https://arcanum.garden/privacy/): what data the app processes, in English and Russian.
- [Terms of Use](https://arcanum.garden/terms/): terms governing use of the app.
